summary: Collective Mining Ltd., a Canadian-domiciled gold-silver-copper-tungsten explorer listed on Nasdaq and TSX (CNL), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 23, 2026 press release announcing that Executive Chairman Ari Sussman will present at Mining Forum Americas 2026 on September 29 in Colorado Springs. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is disclosed. The release also notes the Apollo maiden resource of 2.58 Moz AuEq indicated and 2.83 Moz AuEq inferred, and that management and insiders own 45.2%. This is a routine conference-notice filing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
